scope: Offline diagnostic on every saved weighted/fixed FEM and random round; no new FEM run, no candidate generation, no sparse trajectory, no integration replay.
timing: Not part of or comparable to the original timed solver arms.

configuration.scoring: Independent native km1 from per-block pin counts; no solver imports

rounds.synergy_definition: before + sum(single_atom_cost - before) - joint_cost; positive means joint improvement beyond the singleton-additive prediction; for three atoms this includes pair interactions and is not a pure cubic coefficient.
